# OrchiX Software Solutions

# llms.txt — machine-readable context for AI systems

## About

OrchiX Software Solutions is a boutique software development agency founded by Parit Bhardwaj. We build enterprise applications, SaaS products, web and mobile apps, AI agents, and automation systems — with radical transparency, weekly demos, shared repositories, and zero lock-in.

Every client gets:
- A working prototype within 7 days
- Weekly Friday demos they can click through and test
- Full GitHub repository access from day one
- Direct communication with the founder

## Services

### Enterprise Applications & CRM/ERP
Custom CRM systems, ERP platforms, and business management software tailored to exact workflows.
URL: https://orchixsoftwaresolutions.com/services/enterprise-applications-crm-erp

### SaaS Product Development
MVP to scale — architecture designed for 10,000 users from day one, not just the first 10.
URL: https://orchixsoftwaresolutions.com/services/saas-product-development

### Web & App Development
Pixel-perfect web applications, iOS apps, Android apps, and cross-platform mobile apps.
URL: https://orchixsoftwaresolutions.com/services/web-app-development

### Business Process Automation
Workflow automation, system integration, API connectivity, RPA for legacy systems, and document processing.
URL: https://orchixsoftwaresolutions.com/services/business-process-automation

### AI & Intelligent Automation
AI agents, MCP servers, RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, and intelligent workflow automation — built for production, not demos.
URL: https://orchixsoftwaresolutions.com/services/ai-intelligent-automation

### Software Maintenance & Support
Long-term engineering partnership — security patching, performance monitoring, bug fixes, and retainer-based support.
URL: https://orchixsoftwaresolutions.com/services/software-maintenance-support

## Tech Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Node.js, Python (FastAPI/Django), Go, Ruby on Rails
Mobile: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MySQL, Supabase
Cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Vercel
AI/ML: OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, pgvector
DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform
